findings.title: Giving is sustained by a Lordward direction
findings.claim: The exception makes giving read as a sustained relational orientation toward the Lord's face, with right direction displacing human return and scattered aims.
findings.mechanism: The focus forms supply pursuit, face, direction, and proper course; the same-surah divergence, giving, stinginess, and denial sequence plus explicit devotional face parallels provide independent triggers.
findings.reader_payoff: Giving becomes perceptible as a directed relational act rather than a transaction or a bare inward intention.
findings.containment: The face is not collapsed into one sense: bodily front, direction, devotional purpose, and proper course remain distinct facets. No universal ranking of all possible readings is claimed.

epistemic.reason: A trusted anchored finding is reinforced by legacy reader activations and strong contextual connections, while the cross-lane synthesis remains bounded.

findings.containment: The branch contacts support formation and authority but do not establish the rejected vertical-covenant metaphor or a necessary causal order for every giver.

epistemic.reason: The core publication is trusted and anchored, while the process and broader relational mechanism includes qualified legacy evidence and contextual inference.
